title: Compact Laptop Header
notes: Separates the workspace controls from the document information and sync-status bar on short laptop screens.
Removes the obsolete Finish and Send to Blaster workflow now that cloud documents are available directly to blasters.
Removes the old UNSENT and shared-to-Outlook wording from the workspace detail line; cloud status is now authoritative.
Keeps PDF, CSV, and backup exports available from the document menu.
Preserves the verified m40.8.0 field-entry UI, m40.7.1 cloud loading, and m40.6.2 iPad touch behavior.
